Definition: from G5076; to be a tetrarch:--(be) tetrarch.
BiblicalUsage: The word tetrarchéō is the Bible's way of saying to be a tetrarch. In Luke 3:1, Herod being tetrarch of Galilee. In the Greek text the word is spelled τετρααρχέω.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe to rule a fourth part is still to be judged by the God who rules all.
